m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: How come I never catch a break? Look, I can't afford a war with the Sultana. I got enough problems with the Thuggies and the Fangs.
The Sultana does not want a war. She wants peace - between ALL the gangs. We are here to invite you to attend the Sultana's Truce Talks.
I suppose I got nothing to lose at this point. If Ali Baboon and Loother Ray will attend, then tell the Sultana I'll come too.
Oh, the Sultana's Djinni. You are supposed to protect her, aren't you? Funny how you're not here when she needs you most.
My Master... she's in danger? What are you talking about?
It's the Silent Sabers - they have her cornered in the Lounge. Ozzy was trying to defend her, but I suspect it is too late now.
The Silent... the Assassins' Guild? No! That cannot be. Quickly, Wizard, into the Lounge! We must save my Master!
Stay back, you! You want to get to the Sultana, you'll have to step over my dead skull... well, my undead skull. Even then, I'll bite your toes!
Somehow, I am not deterred. I hope you understand, Sultana. It is nothing personal. We simply have a contract to fulfill.
Wait... a contract? This is about gold? Oh dear, how tacky. Still, if it's gold you want, I am a Djinni. I could conjure some...
Or... I suppose we could do it the hard way. The Wizard and I are... kind of a force to be reckoned with. In fact, we'll just show you.
Your bravado is to be commended, Djinni, but it's for naught. We've slain Wizards and Djinni before. We'll deal with you and then the Sultana.
You have sharp skills, Wizard. Thank you all for coming to my defense. Let's return to the Hall and discuss this unexpected turn of events.
Though this took us all by surprise, it is actually a good sign. For our enemies to send the Silent Sabers, it means we are making a difference.
While the other gangs have merely been trading threats, it seems the Fangs are striking back without hesitation.
Exactly. A group of Fangs Street Snakes are in the River District now. They've cornered the Ferals leader, Achmad Peece, in an alleyway.
Good work, Swan. You and the Hoods keeping watch in the streets is making all the difference. Keep it up.
Wizard, this is the perfect opportunity. Go to this alley and drive the Street Snakes away. Then convince Peece to attend our truce talks.
This is the moment of truth. The gangs are at each others' throats. If we can convince Peece to attend truce talks, the others will follow.
